story_overview: In a sterile interview room, Arthur listens with concern as Nina and Chloe recount a surreal story. This narrative involves Nina and Leo at a monochrome house, Alex's mysterious work in a cluttered workshop observed by Mara, and Casey uncovering a box of old photos. The story climaxes as the photos are burned, and Arthur and Iris kneel in prayer beside a bed.

Black-and-white close-up of Arthur, wearing the black acetate glasses, in The Interview Room. Arthur looks forward with a concerned and empathetic expression, then slowly parts his lips as he begins to speak.
